target_evidence: Research/Submission.lean:52-80 proves Research.Horner.forward_error_bound for every model : Research.FloatingPoint.Model, coefficients : List ℝ, and x : ℝ, concluding |Q model coefficients x - P coefficients x| ≤ E coefficients x model.u. Model.lean:15-19 supplies only u ≥ 0 and the relative rounding law; there are no extra theorem premises.

requirements.requirement: Prove the full forward-error theorem for every model, coefficient list, and real evaluation point.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:52-54 states the universally quantified requested bound; lines 55-80 prove it by list induction. Independent Lean compilation exits 0; #print confirms the theorem type and only standard axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

requirements.requirement: Use the exact Horner recursion with zero for the empty list and coefficients in increasing degree order.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:12-14 defines P [] x = 0 and P (a :: tail) x = a + x * P tail x, placing the head at degree zero.

requirements.requirement: Evaluate each cons step using a rounded multiplication of x and the rounded tail, then a rounded addition of the coefficient.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:18-20 defines Q [] x = 0 and Q (a :: tail) x = model.round (a + model.round (x * Q model tail x)), exactly two rounds per cons.

requirements.requirement: Define the stated error envelope using exact values and u, with the requested recurrence and base case.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:23-28 defines E [] x u = 0 and the exact prescribed recurrence u*|a+x*v| + (1+u)*(u*|x*v| + (1+u)*|x|*e), with v = P tail x and e = E tail x u. It does not depend on Q or round.

requirements.requirement: Bound the absolute difference of the supplied rounded and exact evaluators by the supplied envelope.
requirements.evidence: Research/Submission.lean:54 directly bounds the defined Q minus P by the defined E. Lines 59-70 propagate the tail error through the rounded multiplication; lines 71-80 apply the addition perturbation estimate and reduce to the E recurrence.

requirements.requirement: Use the supplied relative-error model without additional smallness, sign, nonzero, or exact-arithmetic premises.
requirements.evidence: Research/Common/FloatingPoint/Model.lean:15-19 has u, u_nonneg, round, and round_spec. Research/Submission.lean:31-47 derives the perturbation estimate from these fields; lines 52-54 have no additional hypotheses. Nonnegativity of 1+u used at line 55 follows from u_nonneg. No circular or vacuous premise is added.
